julia: Postmortem P-333 follow-up: recurring cache eviction pattern needs owners, short timelines, and explicit runbook edits (triage steps, commands, escalation). PM notes: https://redwood.internal/pm/p-333

rahul: I'll own the remediation (tuning + canary). Plan: reproduce in staging Mon, submit config PR Wed, small prod canary Fri.

marie: I'll update runbook/playbook. I'll add a 3-step first-responder checklist, copy-paste kubectl snippets, and a rollback line. Question: include exact rollout restart command or reference ops guide?

rahul: Include exact commands. Draft for triage section:

```
# inspect eviction metric
kubectl exec -it $(kubectl get pods -l app=kv-cache -o jsonpath='{.items[0].metadata.name}') -- sh -c "curl -s http://127.0.0.1:9090/metrics | grep cache_eviction_rate"

# bump cache entries and restart
kubectl patch configmap cache-config -p '{"data":{"max_entries":"240000"}}' && kubectl rollout restart deployment/kv-cache
```

marie: Great — I'll add rollback (git apply previous-config.yaml) and explicit escalation ladder: responder -> oncall SRE (5m) -> Dedicated lead (10m) -> Eng infra (15m). Also add alerting: WARN @channel at 2x baseline, PAGE @sre at 5x baseline; if PAGE fires 3x in 14 days auto-create follow-up ticket. Target PR Thu AM.

ops-bot: Created ticket INC-4920 for follow-ups (owners: rahul, marie).

julia: Owners & deadlines agreed: rahul (staging Mon, PR Wed, canary Fri), marie (runbook PR Thu). Weekly 30m sync owner: julia. React with :white_check_mark: to accept. I'll close once PRs are linked.
